author: ون بيس
theme: the world of the One Piece anime: the Straw Hat pirates sail the Grand Line on the Thousand Sunny; the ship's doctor Chopper is the recurring healer; stories end with a real line from One Piece, in Arabic
numbering: The book numbers its questions by chapter (47.3); lessons are numbered 1-422 in the order of the jsonl, and the quiz shows the book's own number.
style: a vivid anime illustration in the style of the One Piece anime (Eiichiro Oda's manga style): bold clean ink outlines, bright saturated cel-shaded colour, expressive exaggerated characters, dynamic adventurous composition, every object crisp and instantly recognisable
